notablePrerequisites: Overgrown Battlement does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures with defender.
easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Overgrown Battlement.
description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
